inputRows.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE independent identity proposal for B23 MOTORS, a Birmingham used-car dealer. Exact text B23 on first line and MOTORS beneath. Wide horizontal lockup with a separate compact original B23 monogram on LEFT, clear transparent gap, bold geometric wordmark on RIGHT. Compact monogram combines the B and clearly readable digits2 and3 with open counters, naturally balanced roughly1.8:1 shape, no background tile or borderframe. Deep charcoal #1c2932 and deep burnt orange #9e491d, flat opaque ink with strong WHITE contrast. Substantial strokes, no tiny details, clean at120/180px wordmark and32/64px compact. Genuine transparent canvas/counters and generous margin. No HRM wording or other legacy alias, no car silhouette, shield, crown, slogan, gradient, glow, shadows, white keyline, texture or speckles. New proposal based on current sourced B23 Motors trading name; no official/adoption claim.
